isd.text: Lambholt is the village where, facing the loss of his farm, Arinos summons Old Stickfingers to eliminate Dein Salvasi, but the ritual goes wrong and Arinos disappears while murders begin.
Lakil is found dead in the pasture, mutilated with her sheep untouched, and her death prompts the villagers to seek Vadrik and Rem Karolus, whom Malynn and the council call in.
Vadrik and Rem learn Old Stickfingers was summoned by Arinos, and Vadrik destroys the twig mobile used in the summoning, which only unbinds Stickfingers from its hearth.
Ariosa then finishes the ritual properly, ending the threat, and Old Stickfingers takes his goats and vanishes into the woods.
